newsitem.title: USA: US Oil to cut July crude runs 100,000 bbl-trader.
newsitem.headline: US Oil to cut July crude runs 100,000 bbl-trader.

text.p: Lower margins will force U.S. Oil and Refining Co to cut by 100,000 barrels the amount of crude oil processed in July at its Tacoma, Wash., refiner, said a trader familiar with the facility.
"Product prices haven't shown the strength in the summertime like we'd hoped," said the trader.
Throughout California, refining margins have fallen sharply in the three months starting in April.
Compared to the same period last year, margins have dropped by $3.36 a barrel to $5.69 a barrel, according to analysts.
They attribute weak prices to ample supplies and an absense of disruptions at regional refiners.
U.S. Oil's Tacoma refinery, rated to take in 40,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude, will trim 3,000 to 4,000 bpd from its July intake.
Earlier this month, several refiners, including Tosco, cut runs at San Francisco-area refiners due to poor margins, traders said.
